units.source_text: 在日本棋院干事的引领下，名人独自退到隔壁的房间里去。

en.t: Guided by an official of the Nihon Ki-in, the Master withdrew alone into the adjoining room.

units.source_text: 关上中间的隔扇，在棋谱上写下了第二手，然后放进信封里。

en.t: He closed the sliding partition between the rooms, wrote the second move on the game record, and then put it into an envelope.

units.source_text: 除了封盘的人，如果其他人看见了，就不算是封盘了。

en.t: If anyone other than the person sealing the move saw it, it would no longer count as a sealed move.
